$comment: Snapshot of the MCP connectors installed on the claude.ai account of Pol4720.
Re-captured 2026-09-03 from the live account (ListConnectors) after the previous
snapshot was found to be aspirational rather than observed: eleven connectors it
listed as "connected" are not installed on the account at all, and seventeen that
are installed were absent from it. The file below records what ListConnectors
actually returns.
This file is DECLARATIVE — it records what exists, so the workspace can be rebuilt
on a new account or shared with a colleague. Connectors cannot be installed from a
file: each one is added at claude.ai > Settings > Connectors, and the ones with
"auth": "oauth" additionally require an interactive login that only the account
owner can perform. See docs/03-manual-setup-checklist.md.
Three states are distinguished, because they are not the same thing:
connected              installed, authenticated, and its tools load in a session.
installed_unconfirmed  present on the account, but ListConnectors reports its auth
state as unknown and it is not enabled in chat. Either it
was never authenticated, or it is toggled off.
not_installed          named in the setup checklist but absent from the account.
captured_with: ListConnectors, from a live Claude Code session
